messages:
Maeve (partners): FYI we have a planned breaking change to the native SDK ABI (v2) next month. Need partner coordination for marketplace and SIs.
Samir (eng): We're releasing an ABI v2 with symbol renames. Mitigation: runtime shim behind feature flag enable_native_abi_v2_shim. Two modes: full-emulation and fast-path.
Priya (platform): Marketplace constraint: images must remain runnable. Can we provide tagged images: redwood-native:v1-compat and redwood-native:v2?
Samir (eng): Yes. We'll produce both and a compatibility matrix listing impacted symbols.
Jin (si-lead): SIs need a test harness and a symbol-check script. Samir can you drop that?
Samir (eng): Will push a validator and a simple handshake curl to partner repos by Friday. Example: curl -X POST https://api.redwood.example/v1/runtime/handshake -d '{"abi_version":"v2"}'
Elena (pm-marketplace): Communications: partner advisory next week, marketplace banner + docs two weeks after, targeted customer emails 1 week before hard cut. Legal must review wording.
LegalBot: Please add copy to Legal review doc. Any compatibility claims require approval.
DeployBot: Canary job scheduled 2025-07-08 03:00 UTC. Priya can reschedule.
Priya (platform): We'll add a partner-scoped toggle in Console and auto-rollback if error rate >2.5% over 10m.
Maeve (partners): I'll open the partner doc, invite NebulaHW, AtlasSI, CloudBroker. Will capture contact matrix and testing commitments.
Samir (eng): Artifacts uploaded to s3://redwood-partners/native_abi_v2/ — will share links in the doc.
Maeve (partners): Action items summarized in the doc. Quick migration checklist requested (build flags, symbol checks, handshake, rollback steps). Keeping thread as source of truth.
notes: abi v2, shim, marketplace images, partner-testing
